name: get_live_payments
description: Look up your Floot Payments records in Stripe across all your projects: one record by id, or a list of one record type. Read-only. Reads LIVE mode unless mode is "test", which reads the test payments made in the preview (those never appear in the user's Stripe dashboard). Refunds, cancels and every other change are not possible here; for those the user logs in at stripe.com. Read get_guides('live-payments') before your first call. Responses follow Stripe API version 2026-08-26.dahlia.

created_gte.description: List filter: created at or after (unix seconds).

created_lte.description: List filter: created at or before (unix seconds).

customer.description: List filter (without projectId): a customer id.

id.description: A Stripe object id (pi_…, ch_…, cs_…, sub_…, in_…, cus_…, re_…) to read that one record. Omit to list.

mode.description: "live" (default): the published app's real payments. "test": test payments made in the preview.

page.description: Project-limited list paging: next_page from the previous result.

projectId.description: Limit a list to one project (runs as a Stripe search on that project)

query.description: Stripe search query for a project-limited list, e.g. status:"succeeded".

starting_after.description: List paging: the last id of the previous page.
